title: Check SystemDatabaseModel lifecycle/staging status in Helix2x_1Prod_Robotics (SSMS)
summary: Use SSMS against the Helix2x_1Prod_Robotics database to confirm the SystemDatabaseModel snapshot lifecycle/staging status value is currently one of the expected states (StartingUp, StartUpRequested, Running, ShutDownRequested, ZoneConfigRequested, ZoneConfigStaging, CloseOutRequested, CloseOutStaging, CloseOutStaged).
when_to_use: When you need to verify the current system lifecycle/staging state (startup, running, shutdown, zone config, closeout) by checking the SystemDatabaseModel snapshot status values in the Robotics database.
roles_and_responsibilities: L2_support: Execute the SSMS read-only check against Helix2x_1Prod_Robotics and interpret whether the SystemDatabaseModel snapshot status is consistent and within the documented lifecycle/staging set.

access_required: SSMS access to the WCS / Helix DB (SSMS) surface
Read access to the Helix2x_1Prod_Robotics database and dbo.SystemDatabaseModel
system_preconditions: Helix2x_1Prod_Robotics database is available in SSMS

No inconsistent/unexpected combination is observed (e.g., multiple lifecycle states simultaneously).
healthy_conditions: A single current lifecycle/staging status value is shown in SystemDatabaseModel snapshot status field(s) and it is one of the documented set.
